rows.note: This is the all-purpose medical term for both the injection procedure and an injection shot.

example.english: The doctor said I have to go back for an injection tomorrow.
example.traditional: 醫生話我聽日要返去注射。
example.jyutping: ji1 sang1 waa6 ngo5 ting1 jat6 jiu3 faan1 heoi3 zyu3 se6

rows.note: Use this for additional money provided to support a person, company, or business.

example.english: The company received a new capital injection and can finally keep operating.
example.traditional: 公司收到新一輪注資，終於可以繼續營運。
example.jyutping: gung1 si1 sau1 dou2 san1 jat1 leon4 zyu3 zi1 zung1 jyu1 ho2 ji5 gai3 zuk6 jing4 wan6

rows.note: Use this in computing contexts for inserting code into a program or system, especially maliciously.

example.english: This vulnerability gives hackers a chance to carry out code injection.
example.traditional: 呢個漏洞畀黑客有機可乘，進行代碼注入。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 lau6 dung6 bei2 hak1 haak3 jau5 gei1 ho2 sing4 zeon3 hang4 doi6 maa5 zyu3 jap6
